# STRUCT construction, positional casts and field access follow:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-types#struct_type
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conversion_functions#cast_as_struct
# Raw field values also follow GoogleSQL compliance testdata/struct_queries.test.

SELECT STRUCT('abc', 3)
=> {"f":[{"v":"abc"},{"v":"3"}]}

SELECT STRUCT('abc' AS a, 3 AS a)
=> {"f":[{"v":"abc"},{"v":"3"}]}

# Names that collide with positional internal names remain accessible by their logical names.
SELECT s._field_2 FROM (SELECT STRUCT('kept' AS _field_2, a + 0) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "kept"

SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, '')) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "x"

SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<INT64, STRING>) FROM (SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, b AS y) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> {"f":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"x"}]}

SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(a AS same, b AS same) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "x"

SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>) IS NULL FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<INT64, STRING>) AS s)
=> "true"

# SAFE_CAST fails the entire STRUCT when a field cannot be converted.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conversion_functions#safe_casting
SELECT SAFE_CAST(s AS STRUCT<INT64, INT64>) IS NULL FROM (SELECT STRUCT(b, a) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "true"

SELECT CAST(items AS ARRAY<STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>>)[OFFSET(0)].y FROM (SELECT [STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, ''))] AS items FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "x"

# JSON names follow the JSON encodings reference and GoogleSQL functions_testlib_tojson.cc.
# TO_JSON_STRING retains duplicate names and writes anonymous names as the empty string.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/json_functions#json_encodings
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(a + 4 AS x, TRUE, 'bar' AS foo, DATE '2017-03-28' AS x)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "{\"x\":5,\"\":true,\"foo\":\"bar\",\"x\":\"2017-03-28\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, ''))]) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "[{\"\":1,\"\":\"x\"}]"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON(STRUCT(a + 0, b AS label)), '$.label') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON_ARRAY(STRUCT(a + 0, b AS label)), '$[0].label') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON_OBJECT('item', STRUCT(a + 0, b AS label)), '$.item.label') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON_OBJECT(['item'], [STRUCT(a + 0, b AS label)]), '$.item.label') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON_SET(JSON '{}', '$.item', STRUCT(a + 0, b AS label)), '$.item.label') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

# Script variables hold the logical type, including unnamed fields, across assignments.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/procedural-language#declare
DECLARE s STRUCT<INT64, STRING> DEFAULT (1, 'x');
SET s = (2, 'y');
SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>).b
=> "y"

DECLARE items ARRAY<STRUCT<INT64, STRING>> DEFAULT [(1, 'x')];
SELECT CAST(items AS ARRAY<STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>>)[OFFSET(0)].b
=> "x"

DECLARE s DEFAULT STRUCT(1 AS a, 'x' AS a);
SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).y
=> "x"

DECLARE s STRUCT<inner_value STRUCT<INT64, STRING>> DEFAULT STRUCT(STRUCT(1, 'x'));
SELECT CAST(s.inner_value AS STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>).b
=> "x"

# A typed UDF receives and returns the same unnamed physical representation.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION identity(s STRUCT<INT64, STRING>) AS (s);
SELECT CAST(identity(STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, ''))) AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).y FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "x"

# Nested casts also match fields by position when the inner names differ.
SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<inner_value STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>>).inner_value.y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, ''))) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "x"

# ARRAY casts require compatible element types; SAFE_CAST does not suppress static errors.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conversion_functions#cast_as_array
SELECT SAFE_CAST(items AS ARRAY<STRUCT<INT64, INT64>>) IS NULL FROM (SELECT [STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, ''))] AS items FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> error:

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, '')) AS nested)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "{\"nested\":{\"\":1,\"\":\"x\"}}"

SELECT STRUCT('abc' AS a, 3 AS A)
=> {"f":[{"v":"abc"},{"v":"3"}]}

SELECT COUNT(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(a + 0, CONCAT(b, '')))) FROM t WHERE FALSE
=> "0"

SELECT CAST(s AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).x FROM (SELECT STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS INT64), b) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> null

SELECT CAST(CAST(s AS STRUCT<INT64, STRING>) AS STRUCT<x INT64, y STRING>).y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, b AS y) AS s FROM t WHERE a = 1)
=> "x"

# CASE compares its scalar operand and can still return an anonymous STRUCT.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conditional_expressions#case_expr
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CASE a WHEN 1 THEN STRUCT(1, 2) ELSE STRUCT(3, 4) END) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "{\"\":1,\"\":2}"

# Metadata is constant across a chunk, while field values vary by row or remain constant.
SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(x + 0, 'fixed')) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3]) AS x ORDER BY x), '|')
=> "{\"\":1,\"\":\"fixed\"}|{\"\":2,\"\":\"fixed\"}|{\"\":3,\"\":\"fixed\"}"

# Equality compares fields by position: FALSE when non-NULL fields differ, otherwise NULL when a
# field is NULL. IN is TRUE on a match, otherwise NULL when a comparison is NULL, and FALSE for an
# empty set.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/operators#comparison_operators
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/operators#in_operators
SELECT STRUCT(1, NULL) = STRUCT(1, NULL)
=> null

SELECT STRUCT(1, NULL) = STRUCT(2, NULL)
=> "false"

SELECT STRUCT(1, 2) = STRUCT(1, NULL)
=> null

SELECT STRUCT(a + 0, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) = STRUCT(1, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS y) = STRUCT(1 AS x, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS y) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS y) = STRUCT(2 AS x, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS y) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, b AS y) = STRUCT(1 AS x, 'x' AS y) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "true"

SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, b AS x) != STRUCT(1 AS x, 'x' AS x) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

SELECT STRUCT(a AS x, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS y) != STRUCT(1 AS x, 2 AS y) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT STRUCT(STRUCT(a + 0, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS n) = STRUCT(STRUCT(1, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) AS n) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<x INT64>) = STRUCT(a AS x) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

# A NaN field is unequal to itself, as a NaN FLOAT64 is.
SELECT STRUCT(CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64) + a) = STRUCT(CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

SELECT (NULL, 1) IN UNNEST([(NULL, 1)])
=> null

SELECT (NULL, 2) IN UNNEST([(NULL, 1)])
=> "false"

SELECT (NULL, 2) NOT IN UNNEST([(NULL, 1)])
=> "true"

SELECT (a, 2) IN UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<STRUCT<INT64, INT64>>)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

SELECT (a, 2) IN UNNEST([STRUCT(1, NULL), (1, 2)]) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "true"

SELECT (a, 2) IN ((1, NULL), (3, 4)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT (a, 2) IN ((3, NULL), (1, 3)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

SELECT (a, 2) IN (SELECT AS STRUCT 1, NULL) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

SELECT (a, 2) IN (SELECT AS STRUCT x, 2 FROM UNNEST([3, 1]) AS x) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "true"

SELECT (a, 2) IN (SELECT AS STRUCT x, 2 FROM UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INT64>)) AS x) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "false"

# CASE and NULLIF compare with equality, so a NULL field matches nothing. Values follow GoogleSQL
# compliance testdata/struct_queries.test, struct_equality_null_field.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conditional_expressions#case_expr
SELECT CASE STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS x, a + 1 AS y) WHEN STRUCT(1, 2) THEN 1 WHEN STRUCT(NULL, 2) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "3"

SELECT CASE STRUCT(a AS x, 2 AS y) WHEN STRUCT(1, 2) THEN 1 WHEN STRUCT(NULL, 2) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "1"

SELECT NULLIF(STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS x, a + 1 AS y), (NULL, 2)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> {"f":[{"v":null},{"v":"2"}]}

SELECT NULLIF(STRUCT(a AS x, 2 AS y), (1, 2)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> null

# CASE evaluates only the result it returns.
SELECT CASE (a, 2) WHEN (1, 2) THEN 'match' ELSE ERROR('unreachable') END FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "match"

# BigQuery returns no STRUCT<> in query results, at any depth; these answers are BigQuery's.
SELECT STRUCT()
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_'

SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<>)
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_'

SELECT [STRUCT()]
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_'

SELECT ARRAY<STRUCT<>>[]
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_'

SELECT STRUCT(STRUCT() AS e)
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_.e'

SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a, STRUCT() AS e)
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_.e'

SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a, [STRUCT()] AS e)
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_.e'

SELECT STRUCT(1, STRUCT())
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_._field_2'

SELECT STRUCT(1, [STRUCT()])
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_._field_2'

SELECT STRUCT(STRUCT(1, STRUCT()) AS s)
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f0_.s._field_2'

SELECT 1, STRUCT()
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'f1_'

SELECT STRUCT() AS s
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 's'

SELECT AS STRUCT 1 AS a, STRUCT() AS e
=> error: Unsupported empty struct type for field 'e'

# BigQuery rejects a value table of STRUCTs with an anonymous field, before a STRUCT<> in a later
# field; these answers are BigQuery's.
SELECT AS STRUCT 1
=> error: Invalid field name "". Fields must contain the allowed characters, and be at most 300 characters long. For allowed characters, please refer to https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/schemas#column_names

SELECT AS VALUE STRUCT(1)
=> error: Invalid field name "". Fields must contain the allowed characters, and be at most 300 characters long. For allowed characters, please refer to https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/schemas#column_names

SELECT AS STRUCT 1 FROM UNNEST([1])
=> error: Invalid field name "". Fields must contain the allowed characters, and be at most 300 characters long. For allowed characters, please refer to https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/schemas#column_names

SELECT AS STRUCT 1, STRUCT()
=> error: Invalid field name "". Fields must contain the allowed characters, and be at most 300 characters long. For allowed characters, please refer to https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/schemas#column_names

# A STRUCT whose field names are those the emulator gives a RANGE's bounds stays a STRUCT.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(DATE '2020-01-01' AS `$start`, DATE '2020-01-02' AS `$end`))
=> "{\"$start\":\"2020-01-01\",\"$end\":\"2020-01-02\"}"
